frontMatter.title: Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims – Meath & Navan Players in Action (22nd February)
frontMatter.summary: The Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims take place this Sunday, 22nd February, across Meath, Dublin and Wicklow. Navan is represented in Meath’s Grade 3, 5A and 5B panels as they aim to join other Meath teams already qualified for Finals Day in March.
